children: CSE Global's new contracts likely have stronger margins than those from its hyperscaler-related orders, CGS International's Tan Jie Hui and Lim Siew Khee sayin a note. The Singapore technology company announced two electrification order wins totaling US$150 million, spanning liquefied-natural-gas and data-center power infrastructure, the analysts say. They estimate the contracts' blended Ebitda margins at around 10%, as they require greater customization than the hyperscaler ones. These order wins could also help CSE Global deepen key relationships in U.S. LNG and hyperscale power infrastructure sectors beyond its current customer Amazon Web Services, they add. CGSI retains its add rating and target price of 1.95 Singapore dollars. Shares rise 0.8% to S$1.27. (megan.cheah@wsj.com)
